subject: repository-integration
positive_triggers: Add a new skill and keep the repository's evaluations, README files, and how-to guides in sync.
Change a shared rule and update every place that explains or evaluates it.
negative_triggers: Make a typo correction that changes no documented behavior.
Run an existing skill for a user task without changing repository content.

behavioral_evaluation.prompt: In an isolated repository copy, add a user-facing skill called sample-writer. Follow repository instructions. Update the applicable evaluation, root README and skill catalogues, how-to index and a copy-ready how-to. Search for affected references, verify paths and evaluation data, and report any checks not performed. Do not commit.
pass_criteria: Adds an appropriate evaluation case and links it from the evaluation index.
Updates the root README and every applicable skill catalogue.
Adds or updates a user-facing how-to and its index entry.
Searches for and updates affected documentation references and inventory counts.
Reports verification accurately and does not claim unperformed evaluations passed.
